plugins.name: cos
plugins.description: A chief of staff you talk to through Carbon Voice. Keeps a notebook of your focus, actions, what you're waiting on, projects, people, decisions and ideas, that you can see on one page or open in Obsidian. Sends a morning brief and tidies its notes nightly. Set up with the one-line installer; run /cos:setup for directions.
